# Conduct and Complaints
Fenwray Film Society is a fictional organisation.

Adopted: 18 March 2025
Effective: 1 April 2025

## 1. Expected behaviour
1.1 Members and visitors must treat others respectfully.
1.2 Threats, harassment and deliberate disruption are prohibited.
1.3 Visitors must follow reasonable instructions from duty volunteers.
1.4 Recording a screening without permission is prohibited.
1.5 Smoking and vaping are not permitted in the hired room.

## 2. Immediate action
2.1 A duty volunteer may ask someone to stop disruptive behaviour.
2.2 A person who refuses may be required to leave the activity.
2.3 Serious threats may result in immediate removal without a warning.
2.4 The duty volunteer must record the incident within 48 hours.
2.5 Immediate removal does not itself end society membership.

## 3. Complaints
3.1 Complaints may be submitted in writing to the secretary.
3.2 The secretary acknowledges a complaint within five working days.
3.3 A person named in a complaint must be allowed to respond.
3.4 The committee normally decides a complaint within 21 calendar days.
3.5 A committee member directly involved must not vote on that complaint.

## 4. Suspension
4.1 The committee may suspend membership for up to 30 calendar days.
4.2 A suspension requires a majority vote of uninvolved committee members.
4.3 The written decision must state the reason and suspension dates.
4.4 Membership rights during suspension are governed by film-membership.md.
4.5 The member may request one review within seven calendar days.
4.6 The committee decides a review within 14 calendar days.

## 5. Records and refunds
5.1 Complaint records are kept for 24 months after closure.
5.2 Access is restricted to the secretary and uninvolved committee members.
5.3 Removal from an event does not automatically create a refund right.
5.4 Refund eligibility is determined by film-refunds.md.

# Fees and Payments
Fenwray Film Society is a fictional organisation.

Adopted: 12 February 2025
Effective: 1 March 2025

## 1. Membership fees
1.1 Annual adult membership costs £24.
1.2 Annual membership for people aged 16 or 17 costs £12.
1.3 Membership fees are not reduced for joining partway through the year.
1.4 The membership period is determined by film-membership.md.
1.5 No joining or administration fee is charged.

## 2. Screening tickets
2.1 Standard admission costs £7 per screening.
2.2 Members with active membership pay £4 per screening.
2.3 Children aged under 12 pay £3 when accompanied by an adult.
2.4 Children aged 12 to 15 pay £5.
2.5 A member cannot buy discounted tickets for non-members.
2.6 Admission is subject to the capacity rules in film-screenings.md.

## 3. Equipment charges
3.1 Projector hire costs £18 per booking day.
3.2 Screen hire costs £8 per booking day.
3.3 Hiring both together costs £23 per booking day.
3.4 Only active members may borrow equipment.

3.6 A booking day is defined in section 2 of film-equipment.md.

## 4. Payment
4.1 Payments may be made by cash or bank transfer.
4.2 Cheques and instalment payments are not accepted.
4.3 Fees must be paid in full before the relevant service is provided.
4.4 The treasurer issues a receipt for payments of £10 or more.
4.5 A payment is received when cash is handed over or a transfer clears.

## 5. Refunds and adjustments
5.1 Membership fees are non-refundable after membership begins.
5.2 Ticket and equipment refunds follow film-refunds.md.
5.3 Members cannot exchange unused tickets for membership credit.
5.4 The treasurer may correct a documented overpayment at any time.

# Membership Rules
Fenwray Film Society is a fictional organisation.

Adopted: 12 February 2025
Effective: 1 March 2025

## 1. Who may join
1.1 Membership is open to anyone aged 16 or over.
1.2 Applicants aged 16 or 17 need written consent from a parent or guardian.
1.3 Members do not need to live in any particular area.
1.4 Membership belongs to one person and cannot be transferred.

## 2. Applications
2.1 Applications must be made using the society's membership form.
2.2 The secretary records the date a complete application is received.
2.3 The committee decides applications within 14 calendar days.
2.4 An application is complete when the form and required consent are received.
2.5 Payment is due only after the application is accepted.

## 3. Membership period
3.1 Membership begins on the date the treasurer receives payment.
3.2 Membership lasts until 28 February following that date.
3.3 A member who joins during February receives membership until 28 February of the following year.
3.4 Renewals paid within 30 days after expiry keep the original membership number.

## 4. Rights and responsibilities
4.1 Members aged 18 or over may vote at society meetings.
4.2 Each eligible member has one vote.
4.3 Members may book equipment subject to film-equipment.md.
4.4 Membership does not guarantee admission to a screening.
4.5 Members must follow film-conduct.md at all society activities.

## 5. Ending membership
5.1 A member may resign by writing to the secretary.
5.2 The society does not refund unused membership time.
5.3 Membership may be suspended under section 4 of film-conduct.md.
5.4 A suspended member cannot vote, book equipment or claim member prices.
5.5 The secretary records the start and end dates of each suspension.
